D1.description: Negative / non-integer petId returns 500 instead of 400

D2.description: Missing required 'name' field is accepted with 201 instead of 400

D3.description: Broken object-level authorization: any authenticated user can read any order

D4.description: Latency degrades severely when limit parameter is large (no pagination cap)

D6.description: SQL-like injection payload is echoed back unsanitised in an error trace

D7.description: Missing auth token is accepted -- endpoint does not enforce authentication

D8.description: For petId>900 the response omits the required 'status' field (schema drift)
